title: Place in the sets

blocks.md:
## Overlap

Two sets: **fruit** and **red**. An apple belongs in both. A banana is fruit only. A fire truck is red only. An idea is neither fruit nor red.

blocks.promptMd: Put each thing in fruit only, fruit and red, red only, or neither.
blocks.explainMd: An apple is a red fruit. A banana is fruit only. A fire truck is red only. An idea is neither.

description: Place each item in the left set, the right set, both, or neither.
